description: No IPC permissions. The main window is a remote page (tauri.conf.json app.windows[0].url), every native feature - hotkey, tray, clipboard watcher, updater - is driven from Rust, and the bundled desktop/src/index.html is a static placeholder. Granting core:default to a remote origin would let that origin drive the window/webview/event/app/path commands if the site is ever misdeployed or compromised.
